verdict.rationale: CrewAI's enterprise tier (AMP) documents 'Webhook Streaming' to 'stream real-time events and updates to your systems', which is the product's own real-time event-streaming capability. The evidence is a single thin marketing line limited to the managed platform, and it does not establish token-level streaming or specific intermediate events such as tool calls or steps. The real-time tracing and observability claims concern monitoring, not streaming to a developer's UI, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented token-by-token LLM output streaming, documented event types for tool calls and agent steps, streaming in the open-source framework (not only AMP), API/SDK details for consuming the stream in a UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time
